data.summary:
To secure a challenging and growth-oriented position in a dynamic and innovative organization. With over 11 years of experience in designing and developing large-scale, distributed software solutions, I aim to leverage my expertise in Microservices Architecture, Cloud Comput- ing, DevOps, High-Performance System Design, and AI-powered Search Platforms, I am passionate about creating scalable, reliable, and intelligent solutions while mentoring teams, implementing best practices, and driving technological excellence in software development.
Over 11 years of experience in the IT industry, specializing in software design, develop- ment, and deployment.
Extensive experience in designing and developing enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices.
Hands-on experience in building AI-powered intelligent search platforms using Ollama, LangChain, MCP, Streamlit, and OpenAI Models for advanced document query resolu- tion.
Expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with re-ranking techniques to deliver precise, context-aware, and role-based search results.
Strong exposure to vector databases like Weaviate DB, enabling scalable, efficient se- mantic search and enterprise-grade information retrieval.
Strong understanding of cloud-native development, containerization, and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
Expertise in developing scalable and resilient microservices architectures using service mesh patterns and API gateways.
Strong exposure to AWS services, like EC2, SNS, SES, S3, CloudFormation etc.
Deep knowledge of event-driven architecture, message brokers like Apache Kafka, and distributed transaction management.
Experience in performance tuning, optimizing system architecture, and implementing caching mechanisms.
Strong exposure to DevOps methodologies, including CI/CD pipeline development using GitLab, Jenkins.
Proficiency in relational and NoSQL databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Re- dis, and Elasticsearch.
Ability to lead and mentor teams, conduct code reviews, enforce best coding practices, and drive software quality.
Experience in integrating monitoring and logging solutions such as Grafana, Prometheus, and the ELK Stack.
Exposure to Agile and Scrum methodologies, ensuring seamless collaboration and effi- cient project execution.
